articles.author: Spencer Kimball, Lim Hui Jie
articles.title: Crude oil prices fall for second day as market hopes for diplomatic resolution to Iran war - CNBC
articles.description: The rebound in oil prices come a day after the U.S. and Iranian presidents signalled they are open to a diplomatic solution to Iran war.
articles.content: Crude oil prices fell Tuesday for a second consecutive session, as the market hopes the U.S. and Iran will reach a diplomatic settlement to the conflict that has disrupted global energy supplies for … [+2880 chars]
